title: Full match versus search
description: This example applies the same float pattern to a complete line with fullmatch and search.

steps.description: line contains an assignment statement, not only a numeric literal.
The raw-string pattern describes digits, an escaped dot, and more digits. fullmatch tests the whole line against that pattern.

steps.question: Which call finds 3.14 inside the line?
steps.answer: search finds 3.14 because it looks for a matching substring rather than requiring the whole line to match.

steps.description: search returns a match object for the float substring, and group() prints that matched text.
The search call produces the substring 3.14.
